items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: Well I can remember Morris from a long time back when I was a kid.

ctx.x: bands in New Orleans. Can you tell us anything about your Uncle Morris as you remember him? Naturally we have interviewed directly with him but still if you have any other recollections of him when he was young because some things he might neglect to tell you know sometimes.

Well I can remember Morris from a long time back when I was a kid. And he played, most of the bands he played, he played with Randy for I guess about 20 years or maybe better. Randy was his regular band. He played with some other band but.
At the same time as your father?
